title: Yn scoill as yn obbyr
description: Ten short, simple stories about school lessons and people's jobs on the Isle of Man.

lessons.title: Lettyryn as breeocklyn
lessons.summary: In a Douglas school, teacher Kirsty explains letters, vowels and where the verb goes in a Manx sentence, and Alfie writes one right.
lessons.text:
Ta Kirsty Kennaugh ny ben-ynsee ayns scoill ayns Doolish. Ta ny paitçhyn 'sy scoill loayrt Gaelg dagh laa. Jiu, ta Kirsty ynsaghey reddyn bunneydagh mychione y Ghaelg.

“Ta lettyryn ayns dagh fockle,” t'ee gra. “She breeocklyn paart jeh ny lettyryn. Ayns y fockle ‘ta’, ta daa lettyr, as ta un vreeockle ayn.”

Ta Kirsty screeu raa er y claare: “Hie Alfie dys y scoill.”

“She raa shoh,” t'ee gra. “She ‘hie’ yn breear. Ayns Gaelg, ta'n breear ec toshiaght y raa. Ayns Baarle, cha nel. Ta Gaelg anchasley rish Baarle, as she anchaslys bunneydagh eh.”

Ta Alfie Moughtin 7 bleeaney d'eash. Ta cliaghtey mie echey: dagh laa, t'eh screeu raa noa ayns Gaelg. Nish, t'eh screeu raa er y claare: “Ta Alfie cloie er y vagher.”

“Vel y raa kiart?” t'eh gra.

“Ta,” ta Kirsty gra. “T'eh kiart. Ta'n breear ec toshiaght y raa. Ta shen baghtal!”

“Ta'n anchaslys baghtal dou nish,” ta Alfie gra. “As bee mee freayll my chliaghtey mie.”

Feyshtyn:
Vel lettyryn ayns dagh fockle?
Ta. Ta lettyryn ayns dagh fockle, as she breeocklyn paart jeu.
Vel y breear ec toshiaght y raa ayns Gaelg?
Ta. Ayns Gaelg, ta'n breear ec toshiaght y raa.
Vel Gaelg anchasley rish Baarle?
Ta. Ta Gaelg anchasley rish Baarle.
Vel cliaghtey mie ec Alfie?
Ta. T'eh screeu raa noa ayns Gaelg dagh laa.
Row'n raa ec Alfie kiart?
Va. Va'n raa echey kiart.

lessons.title: Yn kishtey oohyn
lessons.summary: Teacher Jude brings a box full of eggs to a Ramsey maths class; the children weigh and measure it, then empty it.
lessons.text:
Ta Jude Curphey gobbraghey ayns scoill ayns Rhumsaa. She fer-ynsee eh. Jiu, ta'n rang echey ynsaghey mychione trimmid as mooadys.

Ta Jude cur kishtey er y claare. T'eh lane dy oohyn. “Ta daa ooh yeig ayn,” t'eh gra.

Ta Evie Cashen, paitçhey 10 bleeaney d'eash, goaill un ooh. “Ta trimmid beg ec un ooh,” t'ee gra. “Agh ta trimmid mooar ec y kishtey lane.”

“Kiart,” ta Jude gra. “As ta mooadys elley ec dagh ooh. Ta paart jeu mooar, as ta paart jeu beg.”

Lurg shen, ta ny paitçhyn jeeaghyn er mooadys y chishtey. Ta lhiurid as lheead echey. Ta'n lhiurid 30, as ta'n lheead 10. Ta'n lhiurid three cheayrtyn wheesh as y lheead.

Nish, ta ny paitçhyn goaill ny h-oohyn ass, un ooh lurg ooh elley. Ec y jerrey, cha nel veg ayn. Cha nel trimmid mooar echey nish: t'eh begnagh gyn trimmid.

“Ta keead paitçhey ayns y scoill,” ta Jude gra. “My vel un ooh ec dagh paitçhey, ta keead ooh ayn. Ta shen ram oohyn!”

Feyshtyn:
Va'n kishtey lane dy oohyn?
Va. Va daa ooh yeig ayn.
Vel trimmid mooar ec un ooh?
Cha nel. Ta trimmid beg ec un ooh.
Vel lhiurid as lheead ec y kishtey?
Ta. Ta'n lhiurid 30, as ta'n lheead 10.
Row oohyn ayn ec y jerrey?
Cha row. Cha row veg ayn, as va'n kishtey begnagh gyn trimmid.

lessons.title: Bioagyn as bunstooghyn
lessons.summary: A scientist, Maisie, visits a Peel school; she shows the children a cell and mixes two chemicals into a green one.
lessons.text:
Ta Maisie Quilleash jannoo ronsaghey oaylleeagh 'syn ollooscoill. Jiu, t'ee çheet dys scoill ayns Pheeil, as t'ee loayrt rish ny paitçhyn mychione y ronsaghey eck.

“Ta dagh red bio 'sy dowan jeant jeh bioagyn,” t'ee gra. “Ta bioagyn ayns dagh dooinney, ayns dagh baagh as ayns dagh lus. Ta bioagyn feer beggey.”

Ta Maisie taishbyney jalloo mooar jeh bioag. “Jeeagh çheusthie jeh'n vioag,” t'ee gra. “Ta reddyn beggey çheusthie jeh, as ta obbyr ec dagh red.”

“Vel bioagyn ayns dagh red 'sy dowan?” ta Toby Bridson gra.

“Cha nel,” ta Maisie gra. “Cha nel bioagyn ayns ushtey ny ayns aer. Cha nel bioagyn agh ayns reddyn bio.”

Lurg shen, ta Maisie goaill daa vunstoo. Ta coadey er e laueyn, son cha nel bunstooghyn kemmigagh mie son y crackan.

“Ta'n chied vunstoo buigh,” t'ee gra, “as ta'n nah vunstoo gorrym. Jeeagh-jee!”

T'ee mestey ny daa vunstoo. Ta'n mestey glass!

“Buigh as gorrym, as she glass eh,” ta Toby gra.

“Kiart,” ta Maisie gra. “She shen ronsaghey oaylleeagh.”

Feyshtyn:
Vel dagh red bio jeant jeh bioagyn?
Ta. Ta dagh red bio 'sy dowan jeant jeh bioagyn.
Vel bioagyn feer beggey?
Ta. Ta bioagyn feer beggey.
Row coadey er laueyn Maisie?
Va. Va coadey er e laueyn, son cha nel bunstooghyn kemmigagh mie son y crackan.
Va'n mestey glass?
Va. Va'n chied vunstoo buigh, as va'n nah vunstoo gorrym, as va'n mestey glass.

lessons.title: Garey yn scoill
lessons.summary: In March, Phoebe's mother helps the school children sow seeds and plant a fruit bush, covering them against the frost.
lessons.text:
Ta feaillere mooar ayns y scoill. Ta'n feaillere gra dy vel Mart ayn. Ayns Mart, ta ny paitçhyn goll mooie dys garey yn scoill.

Jiu, ta moir Phoebe Lace çheet dys y scoill. Ta garey mooar ec moir Phoebe, as ta fys eck er dagh lus. T'ee cur rass da ny paitçhyn.

“Cur-jee yn rass 'sy thalloo,” t'ee gra. “Ayns y fouyr, bee lussyn mooarey ayn.”

Lurg shen, ta moir Phoebe cur crouw beg er y claare. “She crouw mess eh,” t'ee gra. “Bee mess jiarg er y chrouw ayns y fouyr.”

Ta Phoebe jeeaghyn er y chrouw. “Vel y mess mie son bee?” t'ee gra.

“Ta,” ta'n voir eck gra. “Ta'n mess feer vie.”

Ta ny paitçhyn soie y crouw 'sy thalloo. Agh ta'n emshir drogh ayns Mart. Ta rio er y thalloo.

“Cha nel rio mie son rass ny son crouw aeg,” ta moir Phoebe gra. Ta ny paitçhyn cur coodagh harrish y rass as harrish y chrouw. Ta'n coodagh freayll y rio voue.

Ayns y fouyr, ta troar mooar ec y garey: lussyn, as mess jiarg er y chrouw. Ta ny paitçhyn goaill y troar dys y thie.

Feyshtyn:
Vel Mart ayn er y feaillere?
Ta. Ta'n feaillere gra dy vel Mart ayn.
Ren moir Phoebe cur rass da ny paitçhyn?
Ren. Hug ee rass da ny paitçhyn.
Va'n emshir drogh?
Va. Va'n emshir drogh, as va rio er y thalloo.
Row troar mooar ec y garey ayns y fouyr?
Va. Va lussyn as mess jiarg ayn.

lessons.title: Yn cashtal shenn
lessons.summary: Teacher Poppy takes her class to Castle Rushen and tells them about the Lords of Mann and their power over the island.
lessons.text:
Ta Poppy Radcliffe ny ben-ynsee shennaghys. Jiu, t'ee goll lesh y rang eck dys Cashtal Rushen ayns Balley Chashtal. She cashtal feer shenn eh.

“Rish ymmodee bleeantyn, va çhiarn ec Ellan Vannin,” ta Poppy gra. “Va'n ennym ‘Çhiarn Vannin’ er. Va'n çhiarn as e lught-thie ooasle.”

“Row'n çhiarn cummal 'sy chashtal?” ta paitçhey gra.

“Va, rish traa,” ta Poppy gra. “Va pooar mooar ec y çhiarn er yn ellan. Agh va'n çhiarn cummal ayns Sostyn son y chooid smoo. Myr shen, va kiannoort ayns y chashtal. Va slattys ec y kiannoort: va'n kiannoort reill yn ellan son y çhiarn.”

Ta ny paitçhyn jeeaghyn er jallooyn jeh sleih ooasle 'sy chashtal.

“Va cummaght mooar ec Sostyn er Ellan Vannin,” ta Poppy gra. “Ayns 1765, hooar ree Hostyn y slattys er yn ellan. Erreish da shen, cha row çhiarn ayn ny smoo. Va'n impiraght Ghoaldagh mooar ec y traa shen, as va cummaght mooar ec yn impiraght er Ellan Vannin.”

Erreish da'n traa 'sy chashtal, ta ny paitçhyn goll dys y thie. “Cha nel pooar ec çhiarn erbee nish,” ta Poppy gra. “She thie-tashtee eh jiu.”

Feyshtyn:
Vel y cashtal feer shenn?
Ta. She cashtal feer shenn eh, ayns Balley Chashtal.
Row pooar mooar ec y çhiarn?
Va. Va pooar mooar ec y çhiarn er yn ellan.
Row slattys ec y kiannoort?
Va. Va'n kiannoort reill yn ellan son y çhiarn.
Vel pooar ec çhiarn erbee nish?
Cha nel. She thie-tashtee yn cashtal jiu.

lessons.title: Screeuyn da'n pharlamaid
lessons.summary: Freddie, fifteen, writes to a politician about the status of Manx; his letter reaches parliament and he gets an answer.
lessons.text:
Ta Freddie Brew 15 bleeaney d'eash. T'eh ynsaghey Gaelg 'sy scoill, as t'eh loayrt Gaelg rish e lught-thie. T'eh ny oltey jeh gleashaght son y Ghaelg. Ta'n gleashaght gobbraghey son staydys share son y Ghaelg ayns Ellan Vannin.

Ta parlamaid ec Ellan Vannin. Ta politickeyryn ayns y pharlamaid, as t'ad jannoo ny leighyn. Jiu, ta Freddie screeu screeuyn da politickeyr, Leo Kinnish.

Ayns y screeuyn, ta Freddie gra: “Ta staydys y Ghaelg beg. Ta'n Ghaelg scanshoil son bea chultooragh yn ellan, as son bea heshoil neesht: ta sleih aeg loayrt Gaelg ry-cheilley. Lhiassee-jee staydys y Ghaelg!”

Ta Freddie cur y screeuyn dys y pharlamaid. Lurg daa laa, ta'n screeuyn roshtyn y politickeyr ayns y pharlamaid.

Ta Leo Kinnish jeeaghyn er y screeuyn. T'eh screeu screeuyn da Freddie. “Ta mee credjal dy vel oo kiart,” t'eh gra. “Ta'n Ghaelg bunneydagh son y vea chultooragh as y vea heshoil ain. Ta'n pharlamaid goll dy lhiassaghey staydys y Ghaelg. Bee leigh noa ayn.”

S'mie lesh Freddie y screeuyn. T'eh goll lesh dys y gleashaght. “Raink my screeuyn y pharlamaid!” t'eh gra.

Feyshtyn:
Vel Freddie ny oltey jeh gleashaght son y Ghaelg?
Ta. T'eh ny oltey jeh gleashaght son y Ghaelg.
Vel politickeyryn ayns y pharlamaid?
Ta. Ta politickeyryn ayns y pharlamaid, as t'ad jannoo ny leighyn.
Raink y screeuyn y politickeyr?
Raink. Raink y screeuyn y politickeyr lurg daa laa.
Vel y pharlamaid goll dy lhiassaghey staydys y Ghaelg?
Ta. Bee leigh noa ayn.

lessons.title: Quaiyl 'sy scoill
lessons.summary: Pupils hold a pretend court at school over a missing red belt; Beth is the witness, and Rhys is found not guilty.
lessons.text:
Jiu, ta quaiyl ayns scoill Seth Garrett. She quaiyl son ynsaghey ee: ta ny paitçhyn ynsaghey mychione y leigh. She Seth yn briw. Ta eaddagh doo er, gollrish briw ayns Doolish.

She skeeal ny quaiyl shoh: va cryss yiarg ec Harriet 'sy scoill. Lurg y chloie, cha row y chryss eck ny smoo. Vel Rhys Skelly kyndagh? Ghow eh y chryss?

Ta Beth Crowe ny feanish. “Va mee fakin Rhys lomarcan 'sy thie-ynsee lurg y chloie,” t'ee gra. “Cha row paitçhey elley ayn. Va cryss yiarg ayns e laue yesh.”

“She Rhys yn ynrican paitçhey va ayn,” ta Seth gra. “Agh vel eh kyndagh?”

Ta Rhys shassoo seose. “Va mee lomarcan ayn, as va cryss yiarg ayns my laue yesh,” t'eh gra. “Agh she my chryss hene v'ayn. Jeeagh-jee!” Ta Rhys taishbyney e chryss yiarg. Ta'n ennym echey er.

Lurg shen, ta paitçhey elley çheet stiagh lesh cryss yiarg elley. “Va'n chryss shoh fo eaddagh paitçhey elley,” t'eh gra. Ta'n ennym ‘Harriet’ er y chryss.

“Cha nel Rhys kyndagh,” ta Seth gra. “Ta'n whaiyl jeant.”

Feyshtyn:
Vel quaiyl ayns y scoill jiu?
Ta. She quaiyl son ynsaghey mychione y leigh ee.
Vel Beth ny feanish?
Ta. T'ee ny feanish.
Row Rhys lomarcan lurg y chloie?
Va. Va Rhys lomarcan, as va cryss yiarg ayns e laue yesh.
Vel Rhys kyndagh?
Cha nel. She Rhys yn ynrican paitçhey va ayn, agh she e chryss hene v'ayn.

lessons.title: Yn ellyneyr Iddaalagh
lessons.summary: Lorenzo, an Italian artist, teaches art at a Douglas school; the children paint to a recording of classical music and hang their pictures.
lessons.text:
Ta Lorenzo Rossi ny ellyneyr Iddaalagh. T'eh cummal ayns Doolish, as t'eh ynsaghey ellyn ayns scoill.

Ta çhaglym mooar ec Lorenzo: ta jallooyn echey veih ymmodee ellyneyryn. T'eh croghey ny jallooyn ayns y thie-ynsee. Ta jalloo Iddaalagh mooar ayns y çhaglym, as ta jallooyn veih Ellan Vannin ayn neesht.

Jiu, ta Lorenzo cur kiaull classicagh er. She recortys shenn eh. Ta arrane Iddaalagh ayns y recortys. “Ta'n arrane shoh çheet veih cree yn ellyneyr,” t'eh gra. “Jean-jee jalloo veih'n cree, lesh y kiaull classicagh.”

Ta ny paitçhyn jannoo jallooyn. Ta Imogen Mylchreest jannoo jalloo jeh'n vooir. T'ee goaill yn arrane marish y recortys, as t'ee cur daah gorrym er y jalloo.

“Ta ellyn mie ayns y cree ayd,” ta Lorenzo gra rish Imogen. “Bee yn jalloo ayd croghey ayns y thie-ynsee marish y çhaglym aym.”

Lurg y recortys, ta ny jallooyn ooilley croghey ayns y thie-ynsee. Ta'n çhaglym ny smoo nish.

Feyshtyn:
Vel Lorenzo ny ellyneyr Iddaalagh?
Ta. She ellyneyr Iddaalagh eh, as t'eh ynsaghey ellyn.
Vel çhaglym mooar ec Lorenzo?
Ta. Ta çhaglym mooar echey, as ta jallooyn veih Ellan Vannin ayn.
Vel arrane Iddaalagh ayns y recortys?
Ta. Ta arrane Iddaalagh ayns y recortys, as ta kiaull classicagh ayn.
Vel jalloo Imogen croghey ayns y thie-ynsee?
Ta. T'eh croghey ayns y thie-ynsee marish y çhaglym.

lessons.title: Yn keird aym
lessons.summary: Max, who designs games for a Douglas company, tells a class about his job and the team that makes a game about the stars.
lessons.text:
Ta Max Kinley ny chummeyder gammanyn. Ta'n colught echey ayns Doolish. Jiu, t'eh çheet dys y scoill v'eh ayn tra v'eh aeg, as t'eh loayrt rish ny paitçhyn mychione e cheird.

“Ta mee jannoo gammanyn son çhellveeish as son yn eggey,” t'eh gra. “She keird mie eh.”

“Vel oo jannoo gamman lomarcan?” ta Archie, paitçhey 11 bleeaney d'eash, gra.

“Cha nel,” ta Max gra. “Ta fwirran mooar ayns y colught: ta 12 sleih ayn. Ta ughtar ayn: t'eh screeu skeeal y gamman. Ta ellyneyryn ayn: t'ad jannoo jallooyn bioghit. Ta ny jallooyn bioghit roie as cloie 'sy gamman.”

Ta Max taishbyney y gamman noa. Ta'n gamman mychione rollageyn as planaidyn.

“Va rollageyder ayns fwirran y gamman shoh,” t'eh gra. “Ren y rollageyder as yn ughtar screeu y skeeal ry-cheilley. Ta fys ec y rollageyder er dagh rollage as er dagh planaid. Ta'n gamman kiart, son va rollageyder ayns y fwirran ain.”

“Vel dellal mooar ec y colught?” ta Archie gra.

“Ta,” ta Max gra. “Ta dellal mooar ain ayns Sostyn as ayns Nerin. Ta sleih ayns ymmodee çheeraghyn cloie ny gammanyn ain.”

Feyshtyn:
Vel Max ny chummeyder gammanyn?
Ta. She cummeyder gammanyn eh, as she keird mie eh.
Vel fwirran mooar ayns y colught?
Ta. Ta 12 sleih ayns fwirran Max.
Row rollageyder ayns fwirran Max?
Va. Va rollageyder ayns y fwirran, as ta fys echey er dagh rollage.
Vel dellal mooar ec y colught?
Ta. Ta dellal mooar oc ayns Sostyn as ayns Nerin.

lessons.title: Yn droghad noa
lessons.summary: Harriet's team builds a new stone bridge on the road from the station over the hill in a small parish in the east.
lessons.text:
Ta Harriet Cain ny obbree. T'ee troggal droghadyn. Jiu, t'ee gobbraghey ayns skeerey 'sy niar jeh Ellan Vannin.

Ta stashoon raad-yiarn ayns y skeerey. Ta bollagh goll veih'n stashoon harrish y chronk. Ta logh sheese ec bun y chronk, as ta awin roie veih'n logh dys y vooir.

Va droghad shenn harrish yn awin. Va'n droghad 200 blein d'eash. Agh ayns y geurey, huitt ayrn jeh'n droghad 'syn ushtey. Nish, cha nel sleih goll er y vollagh veih'n stashoon.

Ta fwirran mie ec Harriet, as t'ad troggal droghad noa jeh claghyn. Ta claghyn mooarey ayns y skeerey, er y chronk. Ta fwirran Harriet goaill ny claghyn veih'n chronk.

Rish three meeaghyn, ta Harriet as e fwirran gobbraghey. Ta'n droghad noa troggit ec y jerrey. T'eh troggit jeh clagh, gollrish y droghad shenn.

Ta sleih y skeerey çheet dys y droghad. Ta paitçhyn veih'n scoill çheet neesht. Nish, ta sleih goll er y vollagh reesht, veih'n stashoon harrish y droghad noa.

Feyshtyn:
Vel y skeerey 'sy niar jeh Ellan Vannin?
Ta. Ta'n skeerey 'sy niar jeh'n ellan.
Vel y bollagh goll veih'n stashoon harrish y chronk?
Ta. T'eh goll veih'n stashoon harrish y chronk.
Vel y droghad noa troggit jeh clagh?
Ta. T'eh troggit jeh claghyn veih'n chronk.
